gaps: NAIA women 2011: the 8th poll (Final, regular season, early May 2011) is not readable — NAIA's grid PDF omits it and no archived NAIA release was found.
NAIA women 2016: Final (regular season, ~May 8-10, 2016) poll not found — grid column misaligned and no archived NAIA release captured (Postseason May 25, 2016 was found).

NAIA women 2012-2017 Final/Postseason and 2011-2017 later columns: NAIA's grid PDF prints these columns shifted rows, so they were NOT read from the grid; 2012-2017 Final/Postseason came from archived NAIA releases instead (with points and receiving votes).
2018 ITA DII women: May 16 (final) team ranking page not captured by the Wayback Machine (404).
2019 ITA DII women: May 29, 2019 final (post-NCAA) national team ranking — Google Drive PDF deleted (404), not archived.
2019-20 (season 2020): only Jan 15, Feb 19, Apr 15 lists exist (season cancelled) — not a gap.
2021 ITA DII: all 2021 lists are coaches' polls.
NAIA 2007-2017 grid prints ranks only (points null, no receiving votes) except polls taken from NAIA news releases (see notes).
NAIA grid anomalies (complete=false): 2009 Poll 2 missing No. 22 (ranks 18 tied x2, 19-21 as printed), 2015 Preseason missing No. 17 — absent from the source grid.
ITA fall (Nov/Dec) DII lists are singles/doubles/regional only.
sources_tried: NAIA week-by-week coaches' poll grids (primary, ranks only): https://www.naia.org/sports/mten/Records/Week-by-Week_Polls_-_Men-s_Tennis.pdf and https://www.naia.org/sports/wten/Records/Week-by-Week_Polls_-_Women-s_Tennis.pdf (parsed by x-coordinate; 2007-2017 used)
NAIA poll news releases on naia.org via web.archive.org (primary, with points) — used to fill women's Final/Postseason columns that are misaligned in the NAIA grid PDF
ITA 2017-18 rankings pages on itatennis.com via web.archive.org (Oracle_ITA_Division_II_{Men|Women}_s_Collegiate_Tennis_Rankings/*National_Team_Rankings*.htm)
ITA Google Drive PDFs linked from wearecollegetennis.com posts (Jan 16, 2019 national team lists fetched; May 29, 2019 final PDFs return 404)
